title: powerfit: reproducibility materials for inverse fitting of power-diagram weights
description: Citable DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19673558. Manuscript source, benchmark definitions, final figure/table generation scripts, and reproducibility materials for a manuscript on inverse fitting of power-diagram weights from pairwise separator data. This is a mixed-license reproducibility snapshot: first-party repository content is released under the MIT license, while bundled third-party artifacts under external_software retain their own upstream licenses and notices, documented in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md. The Zenodo license field is therefore set to Other (Open) for the archive as a whole rather than relicensing third-party artifacts under MIT.
